model.name: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B MoE · Oct 10
model.detail: LoRA classifier on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (mixture of experts), trained on October 10, 2026 in one pass over the same 72,000 training passages as the October 7 run: small edits from Claude, GPT-6 Luna, GPT-6.1 Sol and DeepSeek, paragraph edits, AI sections and human paper text. Trained with token, sentence and document losses only (no segment or mixed-label loss); one checkpoint, taken at the end of the pass. Papers are scored in 510-token windows that do not overlap.

calibration_set.description: 2,400 human papers (human by project rule: 2022 or earlier). 2,188 are ICLR 2019–2022, NeurIPS 2021–2022 and CoRL 2021–2022 papers sampled by venue and year from the site's PDF collection, after removing those that share text with the model’s training data; 212 are the 2020–2022 archive papers used before October 7. Three archive papers labelled TMLR 2022 were removed on October 11 because they cite 2023–2025 work.
calibration_set.method: Thresholds are set on all human papers. Each is checked by setting it on a random half of the papers and measuring the flag rate on the other half. Flags cluster within papers, so every interval resamples whole papers rather than treating sentences as independent.

sentence_score: Mean AI probability of the tokens in the sentence (raw model output, not rescaled).

document_threshold.note: The 1% threshold rests on the top 25 of the 2,400 human papers.

caveats: Thresholds rest on 2,400 human papers from 2019–2022, mostly machine learning venues. Topics and style differ from 2025–2027 writing, so false-positive rates on recent human papers may be higher than shown.
Flags measure resemblance to AI-generated text. They cannot separate AI use from human writing that has adopted LLM-like phrasing.

The thresholds are low raw probabilities (about 0.021 at 0.1% and 0.0010 at 1%): this model gives most human sentences scores near zero, so moderately scored sentences are flagged. Very short or badly extracted texts can therefore show high flagged shares.
One training run (one seed). Classifications are model outputs, not conclusions about authorship.

counting.label: Main text only (bibliography and appendices excluded)
counting.note: Sentences in bibliographies and appendices are found from the extracted text (research/atlas-bib-exclusion-20261008/bib.py); the threshold is recalibrated on the human papers with the same sentences left out. Document-level curves use whole documents in every mode.

curves_note: Checked for leakage: 1,196 edited rows were removed because their paper is in the training data or they share a sequence of 10 or more words with it; 5,049 rows remain. This model was chosen among the October 10 training runs partly on its scores on these held-out edit sets, so these curves may be slightly optimistic.
